Name: Viswright
Description: Optimises a copy of the map before VBSP compiles it, checks every change by compiling it with your VBSP and VVIS, and backs out anything that leaks, changes collision or makes more visible. Your VMF is never changed. Tick the passes you want in this step's options; with none ticked it audits the map and compiles it as it is.
Warning: Needs the Compile Pal fork 1.3.0 or later (github.com/catualus/CompilePal). The passes compile the map a few extra times, a minute or two on a large map, less when the map is unchanged since the last run. A failed check stops the compile.
